That's because legal sign-off was expected this month. Given your note about active procurement review and pricing concessions, we'll treat this as an elevated churn risk until procurement confirms.

- Run a quick commit audit with finance to reconcile the ARR contribution and remove any double-counting (Marissa is on copy).

- Draft a short mutual action plan and share with you by EOD for alignment on next steps and timelines.
- If helpful, schedule a 20–30m sync this week to surface any blockers.

Julia — would Thursday 7/22 at 10am PT work? If not, tell me a couple times that fit.

I'll attach a MAP template and loop in Ben to apply the stage/probability changes in the forecast.

Best,
